headline: Fresh Turns Keep Several Fronts Unsettled
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the sharpest movement is in Weathered Expanse and Nevish Line: each logged three and two base-event rows, respectively, in the latest two hours, and 44 and 42 over 24 hours. Weathered remains unsettled at five Warden, one Colonial and three unheld bases; Nevish stands at seven Warden, none Colonial and one unheld. Casualty tallies have also accelerated in both regions. Marban Hollow recorded two fresh event rows and 19 over the day; its balance is three bases apiece and two unheld. Linn Mercy has quieted in the latest two hours after three events in six and 16 in 24, with eight Colonial, two Warden and one unheld. Kuura Strand has had no event in two hours but six in six; all six bases now register Colonial-held. Stonecradle logged two in two hours and remains seven Colonial to two Warden. Mooring County and Stlican Shelf each show two events in six hours, but none in the latest two; all their bases remain Warden- and Colonial-held, respectively. War 140 remains undecided; 34 victory towns are required.
